en: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.

zh: 一篇詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。

ja: 指揮者のために。弦楽器に合わせて。詩。歌。

p.src: 1  May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

ja: に照らしてくださいますように。 セラ。
en: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.
u.src: 1  May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

p.src: 2  That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

en: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
u.src: 2  That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

p.src: 3  let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

があなたを賛美しますように。
en: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
u.src: 3  let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

p.src: 4  Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

々を治められるからだ。 セラ。

u.src: 4  Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

p.src: 5  Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

があなたを賛美しますように。
en: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.
u.src: 5  Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

p.src: 6  The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

en: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
u.src: 6  The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

p.src: 7  God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

en: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
